Their operations, spline evaluations, and sequential solvers require memory access patterns that GPUs are physically incapable of processing efficiently. the 2023 to 2025 era, core architectural innovation has reached a plateau. Hardware constraints have narrowed the acceptable space of design so tightly that the architectural container is now relatively stable. Deepseek R1 serves as the definitive proof point for this era. It achieved state-of-the-art reasoning without inventing a new layer. It utilized the identical mixture of experts container used in previous models. The breakthrough occurred within that container using massive scale reinforcement learning to train reasoning behavior on top of existing primitives. The architecture wars have reached a plateau. Future gains in intelligence rely on the way we train the computations our silicon is already built to run.
